#!/bin/sh
# Shapes node2's traffic through br-lan to ~1Mbit/s each direction.
[ "$ACTION" = "ifup" ] || exit 0
[ "$INTERFACE" = "lan" ] || exit 0

DEV=br-lan
NODE2_IP=10.100.171.11

tc qdisc del dev "$DEV" root 2>/dev/null
tc qdisc del dev "$DEV" ingress 2>/dev/null
ip link del ifb0 2>/dev/null

ip link add ifb0 type ifb
ip link set ifb0 up

tc qdisc add dev "$DEV" handle ffff: ingress
tc filter add dev "$DEV" parent ffff: protocol ip u32 match ip src $NODE2_IP/32 action mirred egress redirect dev ifb0

tc qdisc add dev ifb0 root handle 1: htb default 999
tc class add dev ifb0 parent 1: classid 1:999 htb rate 1mbit ceil 1mbit

tc qdisc add dev "$DEV" root handle 1: htb default 999
tc class add dev "$DEV" parent 1: classid 1:1 htb rate 900mbit ceil 900mbit
tc class add dev "$DEV" parent 1:1 classid 1:10 htb rate 1mbit ceil 1mbit
tc class add dev "$DEV" parent 1:1 classid 1:999 htb rate 899mbit ceil 899mbit
tc filter add dev "$DEV" parent 1: protocol ip u32 match ip dst $NODE2_IP/32 flowid 1:10
